title: Safe Pro Wins Mine Action Innovation Award Sponsored by the European Union at the 2026 Ukraine Mine Action Conference
summary: AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) ("Safe Pro" or the "Company"), a developer of artificial intelligence
body_markdown:
Company awarded top prize for “Scalable Innovation” out of 64 international contestants at the annual competition funded by the European Union and organized by the Geneva International Centre for Humanitarian Demining


AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) (“Safe Pro” or the “Company”), a developer of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled defense, security, and situational awareness solutions, today announced that its AI cloud-based demining solution, SpotlightAI™ was selected as the winner of the “Scalable Innovation” award in the Mine Action Innovation program, a global competition funded by donations from the European Union and organized by the[Geneva International Centre for Humanitarian Demining (GICHD)](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=07nGgxdcJtUApPyvlhZ_xzeot_i0_C1VFGTUJTdhli-JYExijEuZYJMOyNPUzQf4XbaAL-f3oP1qAKf8KRjw8upjvTdcXWkDdPC9OQTnm88RuwlGhpZcJPdDlcxeK6MfvIP55oSQNMJJODAbRzRR9Q==) , recognizing its real-world operational use and potential for wide-scale deployment.


The Mine Action Innovation Award (MAIA) was created to promote the development of new solutions for global mine action. This year, the MAIA evaluated 64 international submissions vetted by a panel of experts in mine action, technology, demining operations, and international affairs. At the awards ceremony held during the[2026 Ukraine Mine Action Conference (UMAC) in Brussels, Belgium on November 17](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=eWPqDyLc9Ru9bZKrzq1Lw0X0tDXMKdKm95E0_zcF_XpkS7t5DrW_HYxQbovd4QlxmMSfe2_49RDjGRNncJKbVTf4t2bJ83VXKlril2sPf2-1Il374G4WtnMbDQjFi4oMQEPzzJz_3cXzn1i1YDh92S-hvppu3rkIa9MAJFxT3csE9rFV0lCABlzLRKgSou0BWtsybKgo4WDwM23WODihR0kzGUbE6Z2OeCbjmEUnAgYEkw6MJU0sjfzyEjsgCOJH-TRiDneLzbT_fnXMsAbNeA==)[th](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Eo9k0fIzDWCyzUR5L7u8PLdlO9IHSAFRemdKFZuWLm2AYt9UaVTjRZdKF_VdalGlvknAaFQ0Wi9ynfvKZ344iFwd89tdb1fclIgyYIjMtPzTtbQCaJEE4QQOTbg7YunivZJAFWT-sPXLLF7c2elPthJV4uwLCr-Sg7_nGL22wG4=) , Dr. Jasper Baur and Gabriel Steinberg, co-founders of Safe Pro AI and inventors of the SpotlightAITM technology, were presented the “Scalable Innovation” award by Her Royal Highness Princess Astrid of Belgium. The “Scalable Innovation” award is one of three award categories in the MAIA competition and is focused on recognizing solutions already proven in operational environments and ready to transition to broader operational deployment, with clear pathways for adoption across mine action programs or contexts.


“On behalf of the entire Safe Pro team, we are honored to have been selected for this prestigious award, a testament to the real-world operational experience we have gained through over four years in support of humanitarian demining across Ukraine. At Safe Pro, our mission remains focused on harnessing innovations such as our scalable AI-powered small object detection and mapping technologies to address the massive landmine crisis in Ukraine and in every country contaminated by unexploded ordnance. We look forward to continuing our work in Ukraine alongside the international demining community as we collectively seek to restore its land and protect its people,” said Dan Erdberg, Chairman and CEO of Safe Pro Group Inc.


According to[Ukraine War Analytics (February 2026)](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=R-eEt1N2JrMlrTh0X6Y-KXfwC8DHaPkLOTipGyi8nUd4dIRrchAkVuS5ykeQC_zreu8WHDAKdYvZ9Xp3Kpp8HZENR5xQAEZ4x-D33kfEWTcXnC7BBpf6GT7gwgPzgKhT99OzsnW-NN08EB299We6tDDeTcXGpoZFk5b-x5BzChjMvHE4uQusceCEn5TCq0rf) , an area as large as 174,000 km2, larger than England, is potentially contaminated by landmines and unexploded ordnance (UXO) in Ukraine. Using existing methodologies, surveying and clearing this land could take more than a decade and cost more than $27.6 billion, according to The World Bank’s Ukraine Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment (February 2026).


The SpotlightAI™ software ecosystem utilizes advanced machine learning (ML) models for small object detection and data reporting built on an extensive proprietary dataset capable of rapidly identifying and locating 150+ types of land mines and UXO. Operating locally for rapid object detection and locating, or through the hyper scalability of the AWS Cloud, SpotlightAI™ can process massive amounts of sub-centimeter-level drone imagery, providing customers with unique flexibility based on evolving operational needs. Enhanced with the hyper scalability of the AWS cloud, SpotlightAI™ can securely generate detailed, high-resolution orthomosaic maps highlighting objects of interest and can plot detection results on customizable, GPS-tagged, sub-centimeter-level, high resolution 2D and enhanced,[interactive 3D maps](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GzR7DX7YuYB2aZWLGBsje5XcdYHhZZx-ejhj3tTugpR0ymVQw_t4VIOR0MD2D75WuB1xByIufzHxYv_9qPrlCetyLOG3ESiDEJjpKHh7y38oIXO3NnDU32NSMOP4CcoM) . These maps can provide a “bird’s-eye view” of the surveyed area, delivering enhanced situational awareness for planning clearing and land release efforts by local governments and humanitarian aid organizations.


Safe Pro’s proprietary AI models have now analyzed more than 3.2 million drone images in Ukraine, pinpointing over 60,200 explosive remnants of war (ERW) across 16,405 hectares (over 40,520 acres). Operating at lightning speed on the AWS cloud, SpotlightAI™ analyzes each drone image in less than 0.2 seconds. In contrast, traditional human analysis can take several minutes per image-a process that could span decades if done manually. Real-world Ukraine detection statistics and imagery can be found at Safe Pro AI’s Landmine and UXO Detection Counter at[https://safeproai.com/landmine-detections/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4qfh7HcOFbngIFRVqW5U8j6BMezpVd4uPJmhdR-4gMsRIE26gToni7U1psTwMTS2xfTxMsStbKYQBU1OuFwusszOZkKKY-gEz9A89mrNmMm2dIIfcSuNy21Jb5oUGny40RySVE0iIcBgx8XJOyGEeQ==)

**About Safe Pro Group Inc.**
Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) is a mission-driven technology company delivering AI-enabled security and defense solutions. Through cutting-edge platforms like SPAI Ground Truth, Safe Pro provides advanced situational awareness tools for defense, humanitarian, and homeland security applications globally. The Company is a leading provider of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions specializing in drone imagery processing and mapping, leveraging commercially available off-the-shelf drones with its proprietary machine learning and computer vision technology to enable rapid identification of explosive threats, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional human-based analysis methods. Built on a cloud-based ecosystem and powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Safe Pro Group’s scalable platform targets multiple markets, including commercial, government, law enforcement, and humanitarian sectors where its Safe Pro AI software, Safe-Pro USA protective gear, and Airborne Response drone-based services can work in synergy to deliver safety and operational efficiency. For more information on Safe Pro Group Inc., please visit[https://safeprogroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4qfh7HcOFbngIFRVqW5U8sagKmRvnlUgu9s-SOCI3v_9EbXX313Y0V18xhsK_GOtPJxg5M4SVApVolp8iNwtXksEOuJ5vdG-JT_N11CPk9o=) .
